annotations.title: Ask to void an unused label

description:
Files a request with SMKlog to void the paid shipping label behind a create_checkout_link session and refund it, for a label that will not be used (wrong address, sale called off). It only files the request: an SMKlog operator checks the carrier and then refunds the card by hand. No money moves through this tool; get_refund_status reports under_review while the request is open, then the outcome. Not cancel_checkout_link, which withdraws a link nobody has paid. Unused USPS labels are also refunded automatically after a few days without a scan.

Parameter rules:
- session_id is the as_ plus UUID id from create_checkout_link.
- Accepted while the session is live (30 days from its creation) and before the carrier scans the label; after a scan label_in_use.
- No label yet: label_not_ready. Already refunded: already_refunded.
- Repeating it returns the same request (already_requested true).
- dry_run true checks eligibility and files nothing.
- 60 calls an hour per client, shared with get_checkout_status.

dry_run.description: True checks eligibility and files nothing.

name: request_label_void

outputSchema.description: The void request on file for the label behind this session.

already_requested.description: True when it was filed by an earlier call
